definition.classification: posthoc; recorded before P13/P14 label rates and AUC
definition.P13: same main L1 cohort; all T1/T2 train/validation/test; prior_like has group precedence
definition.prior_like: any observed same uid/item like with timestamp strictly before anchor; not current state
definition.likes_routes: all; repeated and duplicate events use existence OR
P13_reverse_denominators: all C positives/window event including prior
definition.P13_within_user: nonprior users with both like/no-like pairs; equal-user C-rate difference; no both-C-classes condition
definition.P14: exclude prior; identical D/C/B pairs; unchanged eight raw score families; no fitting or head
definition.matching_snapshot: same all-route/all-play-ratio observed-item set: train29/evaluation149; no model-specific vocab
definition.auc: macro over users with both classes; ties=0.5; seed41/42/43 AUC averaged within user before bootstrap
definition.paired: D minus C; users with both AUCs defined; same pair counts; seed means before difference
definition.ranks: Kendall tau-b, two-sided method=auto on8 families; C/B label-specific user populations on same pairs
definition.A_reference: unchanged day149 models, multi-positive NDCG@10 holdout150-210; not refiltered for validation/known tracks
definition.support_gate: before all new label rates/AUC: T2/test/all-pairs/nonprior/like90 positive users <500 stops
definition.reference_threshold: each marginal or paired AUC population <500 is reference-only

data_audit.timestamp_unit: seconds; multiples of 5; no multiplication by 5
data_audit.timestamp_basis: same Yambda flat revision and seconds convention as listens; DECISIONS.md:7-10,235-245
data_audit.unlike_limitation: 取り消しは考慮できない

like_observation_limit: last like event is not proof of collection end/completeness; original cohort retained
